actions: replaced free state-conditioned 64-sample opportunity oracle as the operational route threshold with a strictly online cell-by-incumbent-bin learner trained on completed A-only proposal pipelines

key_result: The selected online 10-bin cell-local learner matched valueB endpoint quality within paired 95% intervals in all six synthetic conditions while reducing B calls by 5.6%-26.8%; it matched oracle64 within paired intervals in five of six conditions but still used 13%-33% more B calls. Low-incumbent opportunity remained materially underpredicted, and fixed-rate randomized A-only probes did not cure this without opportunity cost.
termination: checkpointed at the physical invocation response boundary with a nonempty frontier; no global completion claimed
